codex-apps.title: Codex Apps
codex-apps.scope: Apps belong to the original session and account. Switching accounts does not transfer access.
codex-apps.authority: Discovery, installation, enablement, callability and selection are separate. Selection never installs an app or confirms native cleanup.
codex-apps.invalid: The original Apps scope or returned metadata is unavailable. No new action is authorized.
codex-apps.unconfigured: No Apps selection is configured. Creating an empty configuration grants no app access.
codex-apps.nativeUncertain: The original native operation is uncertain. Reading state does not acknowledge or resend it.
codex-apps.observed: Last observed on the original controller:
codex-apps.historical: Retained observation from an earlier original generation:
codex-apps.stale: The displayed state may be outdated. Reload before starting another action.
codex-apps.empty: The complete current native inventory reported no apps.
codex-apps.unknown: Current native app availability is unknown. No installed or callable state is inferred.
codex-apps.nextOnly: Save applies only to the next idle execution generation. It does not add authority to a running native controller.
codex-apps.changed: The original session, account or generation changed. Cancel this unsent draft and review the current source.
codex-apps.removeOnly: Choose selected apps to remove from the original live controller. This action cannot add apps or grant new connector access.
codex-apps.receiptUncertain: Admission is uncertain. Only the exact original receipt request may be retried; no second native operation is authorized.
codex-apps.state.queued: The original Apps operation is queued.
codex-apps.state.claimed: The original Apps operation is claimed; native acknowledgment is pending.
codex-apps.state.succeeded: The original Apps operation succeeded. Independent execution cleanup remains separate.
codex-apps.state.failed: The original Apps operation failed. Inspect its saved result; it is not retried automatically.
codex-apps.state.uncertain: The original Apps operation requires recovery.
